## What changed

Describe the focused change and the problem it solves.

## Evidence

- [ ] `modding validate`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `modding doctor`

## Mod contribution checklist

- [ ] Purpose and limitations are documented
- [ ] Manifest is schema-valid
- [ ] Instructions are inspectable and contain no secrets
- [ ] Dependencies, conflicts and compatibility are accurate
- [ ] Examples and evaluation cases are included
- [ ] Evaluation claims identify the model and limitations
- [ ] Content is licensed for contribution

## Risks and regressions

Describe known risks, behavioural interactions, security/privacy considerations and any failing or deferred cases.

## Screenshots or reports

Add visual changes, compiled output or evaluation reports where useful.
